classes.name: Soldier
classes.description: The Soldier is a battle-hardened warrior, equipped with the iconic AK-47 assault rifle, making them a formidable force on the battlefield. Trained in the art of warfare, Soldiers excel in both offensive and defensive tactics, providing a versatile and reliable option for players seeking a balanced and robust gameplay experience.

classes.name: Hitman
classes.description: The Hitman is the embodiment of precision and stealth, armed with a high-powered sniper rifle to eliminate targets from a distance. Masters of covert operations, Hitmen specialize taking out adversaries with deadly accuracy. Renowned for their patience and lethal marksmanship, Hitmen excel in turning the tide of battle.

classes.name: Gunner
classes.description: The Gunner is a relentless force on the battlefield, armed with a high-speed Submachine Gun that excels in close-quarters combat. With a focus on rapid-fire and mobility, the Gunner class is designed to quickly dispatch enemies and maneuver through the chaos of the fight. Whether clearing tight spaces or providing sustained suppressive fire, the Gunner is a versatile and aggressive combatant.

classes.name: Heavy
classes.description: The Heavy is a formidable juggernaut on the battlefield, wielding the powerful PKM machine gun to deliver sustained and devastating firepower. Renowned for their ability to control the flow of battle and dominate large areas, the Heavy class is a walking arsenal capable of turning the tide with overwhelming force.

classes.name: Rocketeer
classes.description: The Rocketeer is a high-impact combat specialist, armed with a devastating rocket launcher that turns the tide of battle with explosive force. Renowned for their ability to deliver powerful blows to both infantry and armored targets, the Rocketeer excels in providing heavy artillery support and disrupting enemy formations.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: The Agent is a covert operative, equipped with an MP5SD submachine gun, blending speed, and precision to navigate the shadows and execute precise strikes. Renowned for their versatility and proficiency in both close-quarters combat and silent infiltration, Agents excel at eliminating targets with finesse and discretion.

classes.name: Brawler
classes.description: The Brawler is a relentless close-quarters combat specialist armed with the Ithaca M37 shotgun, delivering bone-crushing power with each blast. Renowned for their fearless approach to battle, Brawlers excel in breaching enemy defenses, clearing tight spaces, and dominating the scene with sheer force.

classes.name: Investor
classes.description: The Investor is a strategic and charismatic leader armed with the FN Scar, seamlessly blending political acumen with combat expertise. This unique class excels in providing effective support on the battlefield. With the FN Scar in hand, the Politician combines diplomatic finesse with lethal precision to shape the course of battle.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.description: The Assassin is a master of stealth and precision, armed with the deadly FAMAS assault rifle. Renowned for their ability to eliminate targets swiftly and quietly, Assassins excel in covert operations, infiltrations, and high-stakes assassinations. With the FAMAS in hand, they strike fear into the hearts of their enemies with lethal accuracy.

classes.name: Juggernaut
classes.description: The Juggernaut is an unstoppable force on the battlefield, carrying the devastating firepower of a minigun. Clad in heavy armor and exuding raw power, the Juggernaut is designed to dominate the front lines, absorb enemy fire, and unleash a torrent of bullets with the fearsome minigun. When the Juggernaut marches into battle, chaos ensues, and adversaries tremble in the face of overwhelming firepower.

classes.name: Recon
classes.description: The Recon is a master of intelligence and precision, armed with the Kriss Vector submachine gun. Renowned for their sharpshooting skills and keen awareness, Recon operatives excel in gathering critical information, eliminating high-value targets, and providing crucial support to their team. With the Kriss Vector in hand, the Recon class is a deadly force capable of striking swiftly close quarters and at range.

classes.name: Pyro
classes.description: The Pyro is a master of fire and chaos, wielding a flamethrower to bring destruction to the front lines of the battlefield. With a relentless focus on close-range combat and area denial, the Pyro is a formidable force capable of turning the tide of battle with scorching flames. Embracing the heat of war, the Pyro excels in creating havoc and instilling fear among enemies.
